newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares edge lower, dollar sensitives ease.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares edge lower, dollar sensitives ease.

text.p: Belgian shares edged lower in early trading on Friday, with dollar sensitive stocks hurt by a weaker U.S. currency, and with Wall Street seen continuing to dictate overall sentiment in the short term.
Retailer Delhaize, exposed to the dollar through its U.S. unit Food Lion, fell 15 francs or 0.85 percent to 1,760 francs, though an overnight rise in Food Lion shares helped limit the weakness.
Elsewhere, non-ferrous metals group Union Miniere shed 0.52 percent to 2,875 francs and oils group Petrofina fell 0.98 percent to 12,600.
